$comment: Intentional, reviewed deltas between this repo's vendored src/core/ and the GKOS-Engine
at the declared parity tag. scripts/check-core-drift.mjs fails CI on any difference not
described here. Fingerprints are sha256 over the normalised unified diff (file headers and
@@ line numbers stripped, semver literals collapsed to <SEMVER> so version bumps do not
churn this file). To re-baseline after an intentional change: run the checker, copy the
printed 'actual fingerprint', and update the reason to match.
notVendored/liteOnly are empty at v1.0.7: the engine gained intelligence.ts and desktop-agent.ts only after this parity tag. If the parity tag moves forward, declare them there.
The GKX rename (owner decision 2026-10-19; mirrors GKOS-Engine 2.0.0) renamed okf/OKF/Okf
identifiers and OKF+ prose to gkx/GKX/Gkx and GKX. The parity tag predates it, so
check-core-drift.mjs applies these ordered substitutions to the engine's src/ file names
and contents before diffing. 'keep' spans name Google's external OKF specification and
stay verbatim. The policy-hash rule is the SHA-256 of the renamed canonical policy JSON
(identical to GKOS-Engine 2.0.0). Any other difference is still drift.

demo.ts.reason: Product identity: the demo vault's project note is named after this product (Kosmos-Oden-Lite) instead of the former viewer name. Data otherwise identical.

gkx-migration.ts.reason: Doc-comment delta only: the timestamp-precedence comment points at src/core/timestamps.ts (Lite's vendored path) rather than src/timestamps.ts.

gkx23.ts.reason: Product identity: assessor id is tool:kosmos-oden with KOSMOS_VERSION rather than tool:gkos-engine with ENGINE_VERSION. Plus SENSITIVITY_LEVELS is exported so the plugin's default-sensitivity picker reads the one canonical vocabulary.

graph.ts.reason: Doc-comment delta only: Lite keeps the shorter pre-v1.0.6 doc comments on parseSourceFile and buildGraph. Code identical.

incremental.ts.reason: Import-order delta only: the type-only Gkx23ProjectionOptions import sits after the ./paths import. Code identical.

types.ts.reason: Product identity: GkxAssessment.assessor.id is typed as the literal "tool:kosmos-oden" to match gkx23.ts.

version.ts.reason: Product identity: Lite's own version constants (KOSMOS_VERSION / KOSMOS_NAME = kosmos-oden-lite) replace the engine's ENGINE_VERSION / ENGINE_NAME. KOSMOS_VERSION is this plugin's single source of truth (see scripts/check-versions.mjs); the semver literal is normalised out of the fingerprint so releases do not churn this entry.
